summary: The treys ground-truth fixture is far less independent of the vendored engine than CLAUDE.md:16 assumes. poker_ai's own evaluator (vendor/poker_ai/poker_ai/poker/evaluation/eval_card.py) is a deuces fork too: same 32-bit card encoding, same PRIMES list, same verbatim INT_SUIT_TO_CHAR_SUIT = 'xshxdxxxc', same 7462-entry Cactus Kev lookup. treys descends from deuces as well, so the fixture checks a library against its own cousin and a shared-ancestor bug passes both. A genuinely independent check needs a different algorithm family.
